annotations.title: Is this claim already taken by a competitor?

description: Use when the user is choosing a positioning, a tagline or a message and asks whether competitors already say it, whether a claim is crowded or open, or who has moved onto it recently. Reads each competitor's home page today and its Internet Archive copy from a year ago, and returns, per site, whether it leads with the claim, mentions it, or does not, and whether that changed this year, with a verdict: open, mentioned but not owned, taken, or crowded. No page text is returned. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $3.00 per run, charged only when the run comes back sound; pay over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token) or x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed). A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/claim-check.json
